sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL,1,0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL,1,0)) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T1.name), IIF(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL,1,0)) < SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL,1,0)),'YES','NO') FROM longest_absense_from_school T1 LEFT JOIN disabled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name
SELECT AVG(T1.month) FROM longest_absense_from_school T1 JOIN disabled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name JOIN male T3 ON T1.name=T3.name
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy T1 JOIN no_payment_due T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T2.bool='pos'
SELECT bool FROM no_payment_due WHERE name='student124'
SELECT T1.name FROM longest_absense_from_school T1 JOIN no_payment_due T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T2.bool='neg' AND T1.month=(SELECT MAX(month) FROM longest_absense_from_school)
SELECT T1.name FROM longest_absense_from_school T1 JOIN no_payment_due T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T1.month=5 AND T2.bool='neg'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy T1 JOIN enlist T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T2.organ='navy'
SELECT bool FROM no_payment_due WHERE name='student299'
SELECT COUNT(name) FROM longest_absense_from_school WHERE month>1
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM disabled T1 JOIN no_payment_due T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T2.bool='pos'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy T1 JOIN enrolled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T2.school='occ'
SELECT T1.name FROM disabled T1 JOIN enlist T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T2.organ='navy'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T3.name) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T1.name) FROM enrolled T1 JOIN enlist T2 ON T1.name=T2.name LEFT JOIN male T3 ON T1.name=T3.name WHERE T1.school='ucla' AND T2.organ='air_force'
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.school='uci' AND T3.name IS NULL,1,0)) AS REAL)/COUNT(T1.name) FROM enrolled T1 JOIN disabled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name LEFT JOIN male T3 ON T1.name=T3.name
SELECT name FROM enlist WHERE organ='marines'
SELECT COUNT(name) FROM enlist WHERE organ='navy'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM no_payment_due T1 JOIN unemployed T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T1.bool='pos'
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM disabled T1 JOIN longest_absense_from_school T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T2.month=0
SELECT COUNT(T1.name) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy T1 JOIN enlist T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T2.organ='marines'
SELECT T1.month FROM longest_absense_from_school T1 JOIN enlist T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T2.organ='air_force' GROUP BY T1.month ORDER BY COUNT(T1.month) DESC LIMIT 1
